description: RETIRED — forcing extended thinking always-on caused 5-10 minute delays on every request. Smart routing handles effort level automatically.
retired_reason: Forces 'high effort' extended thinking on every request regardless of complexity. With CLAUDE_CODE_SMART_ROUTING=1, Claude already escalates effort when needed. Users who want always-on thinking can set CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT=1 manually.
